title: Bali Honeymoon Getaway | Temples, Tides & Tropical Isles
highlights: Explore Bali as you stand atop the dramatic cliffs of Nusa Penida, rice terraces and temples of Ubud and Kuta’s golden beaches and nightlife in one unforgettable journey.
Capture your special memories in style with a complimentary 1-hour professional photoshoot at Sari Timbul, creating timeless keepsakes from your Bali holiday.
Enjoy an unforgettable romantic evening with a free upgrade to a 5-star candlelight dinner at Mamaka by Ovolo, where gourmet dining meets Bali’s breezy coastal charm.
Rejuvenate your body and mind at handpicked Balinese spas, enjoying up to 50% off on treatments designed to soothe, refresh, and recharge your senses.
Travel back in time as you upgrade to a Volkswagen vintage car tour, complete with seamless hotel-to-hotel transfers, blending nostalgia with scenic island beauty.
overview:
About the Tour:
Begin your Bali adventure with a unique Fin Komodo ride, taking you off the beaten path through lush landscapes and hidden village trails. Also, discover North Bali’s charm with stops at the iconic Handara Gate, the serene floating temple of Ulun Danu Beratan, and the UNESCO-listed Jatiluwih Rice Terraces, before relaxing in the warm waters of Angseri Hot Springs. Get a chance to visit Nusa Penida to explore dramatic coastal gems like Kelingking Beach, Angel’s Billabong, Broken Bay, and snorkel in the vibrant reefs of Manta Bay. Indulge in a dreamy floating breakfast and a soothing Balinese massage, followed by a romantic candlelight dinner in Bedugul. Conclude with a peaceful evening at Uluwatu Temple, where a stunning sunset casts a golden glow over the clifftop sanctuary.

exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: Visa on Arrival (VOA) for Indonesia is not included in your package and must be obtained and paid for at the airport upon your arrival. Please ensure you have the necessary documents ready.
Complimentary activities included in your package are provided as a value addition, but if any of these are missed for any reason, they cannot be refunded, exchanged, or compensated.

Where your itinerary mentions “local lunch,” it refers to an authentic Balinese meal featuring traditional flavors and dishes. Indian food will not be served during these local lunch experiences unless specifically mentioned.
Vehicles will follow a fixed point-to-point route as per the itinerary. Any changes or additional sightseeing requests may incur extra charges.
Bahasa Indonesia is the official language, and Balinese is also widely spoken. However, English is commonly understood in most tourist areas.
The local currency is the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR). While credit cards are accepted in many restaurants and hotels, cash is often preferred in smaller shops and markets.
When visiting temples or sacred sites, dress respectfully: cover your shoulders and knees, and wear a sarong and sash when required (often available at the entrance).

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Bali | Transfer to Ubud | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome! Upon arrival at the airport, get driven to the hotel. After check in, soak in your warm welcome with a decorated room. You can relax for the day or spend the at your leisure. You can step back in time at Goa Gajah, known for its intricate stone carvings, or wander through the colorful Bali Bird Park, home to hundreds of exotic species from across Indonesia. For those seeking fun and adventure, you may also head to Waterbom Waterpark, Southeast Asia’s top-rated waterpark.

items.hotel: Jungle Retreat by Kupu Kupu Barong

days.title: Visit to Mt Batur | Kintamani  Highlands & Batur Hot Spring | Balinese Massage
days.desc: Begin your morning with an early trek up Mt. Batur, where the rewarding climb is crowned by a sunrise painting Bali’s volcanic landscape in golden hues. After your descent, visit Kintamani Highlands & relax at Batur Hot Springs, where warm volcanic waters soothe your body & mind. Afterwards, get driven to the hotel. In the evening, pamper yourself with a traditional Balinese massage, known for its healing touch & deeply relaxing techniques. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

items.title: Mount Batur Trekking in Bali -  Mt Batur + Batur Hot Spring + Kintamani Highland Tour
Balinese Massage in Bali - 1-Hour Balinese Massage in Ubud

days.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour with Vintage Volkswagen
days.desc: Begin your day with a luxurious floating breakfast, served right at your private pool. Afterwards, set out on a scenic vintage Volkswagen car tour. Begin with Tegenungan Waterfall, ideal a refreshing dip. Continue to Bali Swing & take in sweeping views of terraced rice fields. Next, visit Tirta Empul Temple, renowned for its holy spring pools & Tegallalang Rice Terrace, layered fields that capture Bali’s timeless beauty. Afterwards, get driven back to the hotel.

items.title: Transfer in Vintage Volkswagen
items.desc: 1 X Vintage Volkswagen will be Provided

items.title: Central Bali Sightseeing Tour with Tirta Empul Temple - Bali Swing + Tegenungan Waterfall + Tirta Empul + Sari Timbul + Tegallang Rice Terrace Tour on a Vintage Volkswagen

days.title: Bedugul Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, set out to discover Bedugul. Begin at the iconic Handara Gate, admired for its traditional Balinese design set against a dramatic mountain backdrop to capture memorable photos. Continue your journey to the serene Ulun Danu Beratan Temple, a floating shrine resting on Lake Beratan. Later, venture on a short trek to the secluded Leke Leke Waterfalls, where crystal-clear waters cascade through lush tropical greenery. Afterwards, get driven back to the hotel.

items.title: Full Day Bedugul Tour in Bali - Handara Gate + Ulun Danu Beratana + Leke Leke Waterfalls + Wanagiri Hills

days.title: Transfer to Nusa Penida | Nusa Penida West Tour
days.desc: In the morning, get driven to Sanur Port & board a speedboat to Nusa Penida. Upon arrival, explore Kelingking Beach, where the dramatic T-Rex–shaped cliffs create one of Bali’s most iconic views. Continue to Angel’s Billabong, a natural infinity pool & striking rock formations of Broken Bay, known for its dramatic arch. Also, visit Paluang Cliff for sweeping coastal panoramas & Crystal Bay, a serene beach with golden sands. Later, get driven to the hotel & check in for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Speed Boat
items.desc: 1 X Speed Boat will be Provided

items.title: Nusa Penida West Tour - Kelingking Beach + Angel Billabong + Broken Bay + Crystal Bay + Paluang Cliff

days.title: Nusa Penida East Tour
days.desc: Today, begin your exploration with Diamond Beach, known for its dramatic cliffs. Just nearby, visit Atuh Beach, perfect for a refreshing escape & Thousand Island View Point, offering panoramas of rugged cliffs. Don’t miss Rumah Pohon Tree House, perched high on the cliffs, offering one of the most breathtaking sunrise. End your journey at the whimsical Teletubbies Hill, where rolling green hills create a serene landscape. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

items.title: Nusa Penida East Tour - Diamond Beach + Atuh Beach + Tree House + Teletabis Hill + Thousand Island Viewpoint

days.title: Water Sports at Tanjung Benoa Beach | Uluwatu Sunset Tour with Kecak Fire Show | Visit to Kuta Market
days.desc: Post check out, get driven to Toya Pakeh Harbour & board the speedboat to Kuta. Upon arriving, get driven to Tanjung Benoa Beach & enjoy water sports like jet skiing, parasailing & banana boat ride. After the adventure, unwind at the stunning Melasti Beach & visit Uluwatu Temple & enjoy Kecak Dance as the sun dips into golden hues. Later, stroll through the lanes of Kuta Market, soaking in its lively atmosphere. Afterwards, get driven to the hotel & check in for an overnight stay.

days.title: Candlelight Dinner Experience | Day at Leisure
days.desc: In the morning, spend the day at your leisure. You can visit New Kuta Green Park, where exciting rides and activities make it a great spot for leisure and entertainment, or explore Kuta Beach, perfect for sunbathing & surfing. Later, in the evening, make your journey memorable with a romantic candlelight dinner at Mamaka by Ovolo, blending fine dining with the stunning beachfront ambience & delicious dishes. Later, get driven back to the hotel.

items.title: Candle Light Dinner at Mamaka by Ovolo

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the monring, get ready & check out from the hotel. You'll be driven to the airport. This is where your trip comes to an end.
